title: Great idea…….
text: Great idea…….. The first thing I thought after opening that pack is the holder looks nice, but it really is not functional. Even if there was a cover over the stones, I would not be comfortable using the wood tray.  When I washed the stones, I tried to wash the tray. Stain came off the tray onto the sponge. I placed the  stones in a ziploc and placed in the freezer.  After a few days I gave the stones a try.  They simply did it chill the scotch enough.  Not sure if bigger stones would make much difference.
